issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies addGuestStudents(int): void (no return value), but the solution implementation declares addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and return behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to declare addGuestStudents(int) as void and perform the addition (handling invalid input via exceptions or ignoring negatives), or (B) update the problem statement/UML and instructions to specify that addGuestStudents(int) returns a boolean indicating success and explain the return semantics. Prefer aligning the solution to the UML (option A) unless the boolean return was intentional, in which case update the UML and textual description to match.
